messages.subject: Actual CLI repro: preflight silently skips strict validator; smoke invalid class metrics
messages.body: Confirmed direct command bug: write V04 config with training.unknown_flag=true then python /repo/scripts/volume_preflight.py --config /tmp/.../V04.json (cwd /tmp) returns PASS exit0; validate_volume_config(same object) raises unknown training fields. scripts/volume_preflight.py:114-119 catches ImportError and silently degrades because direct script has no repo-root bootstrap. Actual unmocked CPU V04 smoke --steps 1 passes but emits present_foreground=23, absent_foreground=-20 and pseudo_coverage=.078857 at accepted=969/valid=969 (denominator appears padded 12288); teacher_student_disagreement NOT_AVAILABLE. Route strict-preflight fix to tooling and invalid metrics/denominator to loss/integration owners; frozen eval currently synthetic-only and aggregates dataset-pooled confusion without native inversion (evaluation.py:61-87), while deployment load rebuilds DINO from original source/weights before applying exported state (:140-143), so integration owner should cover these required paths.

messages.subject: P1 correction forbidden mask read and UNKNOWN corruption
messages.body: Verified with instrumented scripts.volume_correct._load_volume: main --image IMAGE --simulate-from-gt TEST_MASK --dataset-role TEST opens both IMAGE and TEST_MASK before rejecting; role check at correction.py:637+ happens after CLI mask load at scripts/volume_correct.py:160+. Fix unknown/prior support and no-prompt branch; existing 47 focused tests PASS but miss these failures.

messages.subject: P1 geometry: sparse-frame sampling, padding, export support
messages.body: Confirmed data.py:199-204 chooses t uniformly over all cine frames before _mask, so legal sparse ED/ES label manifest breaks: fixture shape=(10,3,5,7), keep L masks 0/5, RNG0 -> ValueError missing mask frame8. Choose labeled frame IDs explicitly and do not copy them across time. _choose_slab:166-171 clips padded Z and :237 marks all duplicates valid: center0 depth5 Z3 returns [0,0,0,1,2], all35 voxels valid each; exclude padding from objective/region motion and ensure physical grid semantics. geometry.py:225-226 interpolates probabilities linearly but support nearest: native width5/current width3 spacingX2 crop current x1:3 -> exported native x1 declared valid with probability sum0.5; require full interpolation stencil support and carry emitted geometric_valid. Full repro will be in review_geometry_aux.md.

messages.subject: Trainer repro: zero pseudo-weight still mutates AdamW; warmup one step late
messages.body: On current engine CPU Toy head Conv3d, default config + pseudo_threshold=0, pseudo_weight=0, constant scheduler/lr_warmup_steps=4: first transaction invokes two optimizer steps, pseudo CE=0 and gradient_norm=0 yet pseudo parameter L1 delta=0.03216287866 (Adam momentum/decay); pseudo_updates=1. Both steps use head LR0.003, though step0 warmup requires0.00075; scheduler is applied only after updates. Require zero-weight/no-aux skip and apply outer schedule before supervised/pseudo, test actual LR observed at optimizer step. Config silently rewrites scheduler_only to grouped_adamw and amp_bf16 to FP16 amp; reject unsupported intent rather than changing factors. V04 new parameters6176 versus V05 10742 (+73.9% new branch, whole model +3.48%); expose this plus skip change in control metadata.

messages.subject: Evaluation/export and resume acceptance tests needed
messages.body: Current evaluate_frozen pools all batch voxels before Dice and never calls invert_probabilities or groups frame/patient IDs; this changes existing mean-of-frame/patient native-grid metric. volume_evaluate.py only supports manufactured all-BG tensors and real path unconditionally raises, so executable frozen held-out path remains missing. Export loader defaults synthetic=True from absent config.data.synthetic; a real DINO export is rebuilt as TinyEncoder, while synthetic=False rebuild would require original pretrained files instead of architecture-only deployment. Current resume test only checks immediately loaded Toy weights (no next-step, EMA/optimizer/scheduler/cache/RNG equivalence), source digest excludes canonical executed deps, config_sha256 is stored but not validated. Please cover these during integration followup; await owner-ready checkpoint before final acceptance.

messages.subject: P1 temporal invalid-support and bounded-motion failures
messages.body: Independent nonidentity translation phantom recovers dx2 and warp MAE0 globally, but register_volumes ignores current_valid/adjacent_valid entirely (temporal.py:227-341). Keeping valid anatomy dx2 fixed while adding bright invalid-band texture shifted dx6 changes estimated dx to6.00018. Warped validity at :449-453 is nearest despite bilinear teacher probabilities, so x+0.25 can mix invalid neighbor yet produce student gradient (observed +/-0.166667). Also phase peak is clipped after unrestricted argmax :221-224 instead of search/reject: true dx6 bound2 becomes dx2, forward-backward symmetric clipping accepts 1105 voxels. Need fail-closed registration support/quality and conservative interpolation masks; slice-wise path pairs same zi despite nonzero dz and checks backward flow without mapped-coordinate sampling.
